pages.title: Crafting the Scholar Table
pages.text: The brush and cinnabar blood ink in this recipe are tools. Both remain in the crafting grid after the table is made. Right-click the table to open its interface.

pages.title: Finding Torn Pages
pages.text: Torn Pages may appear in chests from Ancient Cities, Desert Pyramids, Jungle Temples, Ruined Portals, and Underwater Ruins. Each eligible chest yields 0 to 3 pages.$(br2)Complete manuals never generate directly in wild loot chests.

pages.title: Analyzing Pages
pages.text: Place Torn Pages in the Scholar Table's Analysis page to analyze them automatically.

pages.title: One Book, One Array
pages.text: Place the Ancient Book produced by analyzing Torn Pages into Decipher to begin breaking its array.
